methods: Original pixel units, both sources1254x1254. No PNG, anchor, scale, catalog or old report edited.
Source SHA pins bind all reference semantic selections. Eye tracking is expression-sensitive; closed or unreliable face sections remain null.
Hat height is the white fill component height, excluding black outline; this is a repeatable hat proxy with approximately2px edge uncertainty.
Visible feet are two disconnected coral-pink components in the lowest30percent body band, each area>500px. Original source frames were visually checked to distinguish feet from hands/badge/cushion.
Foot baseline is the lower of those actual foot-fill component bounds, not the opaque cushion or region anchor. Pink fill excludes outline; approximately2px edge uncertainty.
Eye-line-to-foot is a pose proxy, not inferred hidden torso anatomy. Face width is visible pink face cross-section at the lower eye rims; eye separation is not pupil distance.
This independent new review does not retroactively replace the old whole-library report's conservative unmeasured foot entries.
Uniform common canvas only ensures extraction. No per-frame scaling or geometric smoothing is used.

sourcePixelDrift.registration: 1:1 source pixels, each frame integer translated by existing region anchor; no scaling or warping
sourcePixelDrift.limitation: Registration isolates residual artwork/pixel differences, not same raw atlas coordinates. RGB differences at alpha0 are ignored. A nonzero error is evidence of changed pixels, not proof every change is perceptually harmful.

visualFindings.message: Correct-alpha5x nearest-neighbor inspection alongside v2 shows a whole oval cookie on the plate. The slightly uneven left edge is not the clear missing bite from frames6-11. Requested targeted repair was not achieved.

All11 non-target frames have changed RGBA pixels after integer anchor registration. Strong silhouettes remain close, with only0-2px width and-1..1px height changes. Do not claim exact preservation or assume all pixel changes are visually harmful.
Mint costume, white eyes/pink eyelids, enlarged face, shorter hat, feet and story poses closely resemble v2. The existing5-to6 bite-release transition still needs live-speed review.

recommendation: Retain both sources as evidence; prefer v2 over calling this a successful targeted edit. Cookie redraw remains necessary; no main integration approval.
